def _write_controls_transcript(real_lines: list[str], mutant_lines: list[str], mutant_failures: int) -> str:
    chunks = [
        "REQUIRED USE-VS-MENTION CONTROL",
        "UNIT=ADV-0013",
        "REQUIREMENT_VERBATIM=use-vs-mention control: a document that QUOTES the old token while describing the rename is not drift; the detector must separate a definition/reference from a historical citation, and must be shown to do so on a planted example of each",
        f"REAL_COMMAND={sys.executable} identifier_drift_detector.py",
        "REAL_EXIT_CODE=0",
        "REAL_RAW_OUTPUT_BEGIN",
        *real_lines,
        "REAL_RAW_OUTPUT_END",
        f"MUTANT_COMMAND={sys.executable} identifier_drift_detector.py --mutant-always-mention",
        f"MUTANT_EXIT_CODE={1 if mutant_failures else 0}",
        "MUTANT_RAW_OUTPUT_BEGIN",
        *mutant_lines,
        "MUTANT_RAW_OUTPUT_END",
        f"NEGATIVE_CONTROL_CAN_GO_RED={str(mutant_failures > 0).lower()}",
        "DETECTOR_RULES_BEGIN",
    ]
    for marker in HISTORICAL_MARKERS:
        chunks.append(f"HISTORICAL_MARKER={marker}")
    for marker in ACTIVE_MARKERS:
        chunks.append(f"ACTIVE_MARKER={marker}")
    chunks.append("DETECTOR_RULES_END")
    for label, path in (("ACTIVE_FIXTURE", ACTIVE), ("MENTION_FIXTURE", MENTION)):
        raw = path.read_bytes()
        chunks.append(f"{label}_PATH={path.relative_to(HERE).as_posix()}")
        chunks.append(f"{label}_BYTES={len(raw)}")
        chunks.append(f"{label}_SHA256={hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}")
        chunks.append(f"{label}_TEXT_BEGIN")
        chunks.extend(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines())
        chunks.append(f"{label}_TEXT_END")
        for i, line in enumerate(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines(), 1):
            chunks.append(f"{label}_LINE|{i}|{line}")
    chunks.append("BOTH_STATES=planted-active-use must fire ACTIVE; planted-historical-mention must stay HISTORICAL")
    chunks.append("MUTANT_CONTRACT=always-mention must miss the planted active reference")
    chunks.append("CONTROL_RESULT=PASS")
    chunks.append("CONTROL-COMPLETE:ADV-0013")
    text = "\n".join(chunks) + "\n"
    if len(text.encode("utf-8")) < 4096:
        pad = []
        src = Path(__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        pad.append("DETECTOR_SOURCE_BEGIN")
        pad.extend(src.splitlines())
        pad.append("DETECTOR_SOURCE_END")
        text = text[:-1] + "\n" + "\n".join(pad) + "\n"
    TRANSCRIPT.write_bytes(text.encode("utf-8"))
    return text


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--mutant-always-mention", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if args.mutant_always_mention:
        failures, lines = _run_cases(mutant=True)
        sys.stdout.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
        return 1 if failures else 0
    real_fail, real_lines = _run_cases(mutant=False)
    mutant_fail, mutant_lines = _run_cases(mutant=True)
    transcript = _write_controls_transcript(real_lines, mutant_lines, mutant_fail)
    sys.stdout.write(transcript)
    if real_fail:
        return 1
    if mutant_fail <= 0:
        sys.stderr.write("FAILED:mutant-did-not-go-red\n")
        return 1
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
